info.title: API Adopciones
info.description: API REST profesional para gestión de adopciones

get.description: Returns statistics about animals and adoption requests. Only accessible by admin users.
Admins can view all adoption requests. Adopters can only view their own requests.

post.description: Creates a new adoption request for the authenticated adopter.

patch.description: Only admins can approve a pending adoption request. The related animal will be marked as adopted.
Only admins can reject a pending adoption request.
Allows the owner of the request to cancel it if it is still pending.

get.description: Verifies that the API is running correctly

password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
